method_boundaries.graph: Only adjacent-layer longitudinal edges; a contiguous empty-layer run separates occupied sides, but the aggregate gap count counts layers rather than runs.
method_boundaries.bootstrap: The stored interval resamples pairs within incident-energy bins; repeated inspection of the validation bank precludes confirmatory interpretation.
method_boundaries.split_hashes: Pilot and canonical split manifests differ; the exact pilot-validation/bank overlap is unresolved.
method_boundaries.ai_use: Author states Codex/GPT-5.6-Sol assisted code and manuscript drafting and analysis/model proposals; author supplied main ideas and checked the work.
method_boundaries.c2st: Original three-seed shower-aware scores exceed the declared high-level gate but use row-wise matched-pair splitting; separate pair-grouped validation monitor has its own bank. Neither is an untouched test.
method_boundaries.response_clip: The response cap and possible clipping to zero follow implementation; aggregate clipping frequencies were not retained.

model_description.mechanism_claim_boundary: implementation behavior only; no adequacy, convergence, causal, or architecture-superiority claim
